results.question: Retype lake-magog through a kind-map or type-map change (code and test), or keep it as a protected place until PA-R-CA models the Mount Assiniboine core-area zone?
results.reason: Lake Magog is a lake (water.body.lake, profile lake); its type nature.protected.nature_reserve came from the legacy pair sight/area. Retyping needs its suitability record to become lake/lake, but migrated-offplan.json is pinned byte for byte by the suitability migrate --check test, and migration.test pins type = legacy default of the suitability kind (profile area). Tried and reverted.

results.question: Move the conservation pass to a PA-R-CA requirement offer and then retype, or keep the area type?

Tried and reverted.
